title: Count Hills and Valleys in an Array
goal: Count hills and valleys while treating adjacent equal values as one plateau.
strategy: Compress each equal run to one height. Only interior compressed values can have both neighbors, and strict comparisons identify hill and valley plateaus once each.

phasePurposes.start: Count hills and valleys while treating adjacent equal values as one plateau.

phasePurposes.done: Count hills and valleys while treating adjacent equal values as one plateau.

edgeCases: A constant plateau has no two distinct neighboring heights
Monotone heights have no hill or valley
One interior plateau is one hill
